pr_title: br/lightning: don't make NextMajorVersion() crash if ReleaseVersion is not a semver
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #29185

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

If `build.ReleaseVersion` cannot be parsed as a semver just assume it is built from source without tag information and make `NextMajorVersion()` return `MaxInt64.0.0-nightly`.

issue_context.title: Lightning: Crashes if built without git tags
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

1. Clone the tidb repo directory, without any tags
2. `make build_lightning`
3. `bin/tidb-lightning --help`

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

Lightning's help page.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```
panic: b7ed87d is not in dotted-tri format

goroutine 1 [running]:
github.com/coreos/go-semver/semver.Must(...)
        /go/pkg/mod/github.com/coreos/go-semver@v0.3.0/semver/semver.go:65
github.com/coreos/go-semver/semver.New(0xc00089a980, 0x7, 0xc00089a980)

        /go/pkg/mod/github.com/coreos/go-semver@v0.3.0/semver/semver.go:49 +0x77
github.com/pingcap/tidb/br/pkg/version.NextMajorVersion(0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0)
        /data/tidb/br/pkg/version/version.go:35 +0x70
github.com/pingcap/tidb/br/pkg/lightning/backend/importer.init()
        /data/tidb/br/pkg/lightning/backend/importer/importer.go:53 +0x145
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

master

review_comments:
```suggestion
		return semver.Version{PreRelease: "nightly"}
```
I think we should make next version to 0 so it will fail all the version check.
BTW, shall we output a `WARN` log here
@glorv since `NextMajorVersion` is used in init code which runs before `main()`, the WARN log will simply be lost. we could `Fprint` to stderr though if you like.
